title: Pick the Adapter
briefMd:
# Pick the Adapter

You have **800 labelled examples** for a domain FAQ assistant. Budget is tight; full fine-tune of a 7B model would cost ~€2,400 and risks overfitting on this slice.

Frozen options on the table:

| Method | Typical fit |
|---|---|
| **Prompt only** | < 200 examples or fast iteration |
| **LoRA** | hundreds to low thousands of examples |
| **Full fine-tune** | large budget + thousands of examples |

Pass when you pick **LoRA** and justify it with **data scarcity** or **cost** — not “quality at any price”.
